statement: Every configured anonymous HackerRank source row returned an HTTP 403 access gate during the formal Playwright acquisition.

No HackerRank account or authenticated browser session was supplied, so dashboard, editor mutation, runs, submissions, history, saved challenges, progress, and settings were not observed on the source.
Learner accounts and practice mutations use a site-isolated local SQLite contract. They make no direct-source behavior or pixel-fidelity claim.
